title: This year's Berne lineup with Peanuts Hucko and the radio big band
summary: He plans two Dixieland swing bands, Kenny Davern and Pee Wee Erwin, and Peanuts Hucko with the Swiss radio band playing Glenn Miller arrangements.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And, each year you get more Condon guys over there - don't you?
Well, this year, I'm going to have all the ones left in the Condon band-- I've got all of them and I've got one other whole American band---
Beside that - yeah - playing the same kind of music.
Who is that going to be?
Well, it will be like Kenny Davern and those guys--

And, uh, Pee Wee Erwin and, uh, some of those guys; we're going to have two Dixie Land swing jazz band type bands this year. And, of course, Peanuts Hucko will be there and he is going to be playing with what they call their big radio band in Switzerland which I hear is a magnificent band.
What Peanuts is going to do with that big band - apparently, Peanuts has some of the original arrangements from the Glen Miller Band.
Which he was in for awhile - right?
Which he was in and now they're going to let Peanuts do that thing and that's a big band; that's about twenty pieces besides Peanuts. So, you see what they're doing now--
A lot of recreating is what they're doing for one thing-- right? Recreating some great music from the past---
